newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Lufthansa to upgrade CIS passenger flights.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa to upgrade CIS passenger flights.

text.p: Deutsche Lufthansa AG will upgrade passenger services on flights to five CIS destinations from November 1, the airline said in a statement on Monday.

"Special check-in desks for business class passengers will be set up at airports in Moscow, St Petersburg, Nizhny Novgorod, Samara and Minsk, the Belarussian capital," the statement, issued by the airline's Moscow office said.
It added that business class passengers would be able to carry two pieces of hand lagguage in the cabin. Economy class passengers will carry only one piece.
The statement also said Lufthansa Boeing 737, A-320 and A-321 aircraft flying to CIS airports would have new leather seats. "The number of seats in business class will be reduced," it said.
A spokeswoman told Reuters the new standards would be fully introduced on CIS routes by the end of 1997.
Lufthansa currently flies to 13 destinations in the Commonwealth of Independent States.
Other European routes will be upgraded as well, Lufthansa said.
